desc: The XC3 is ideal for duty use as well as concealed-carry handgun applications. It is engineered to perform in any high-stress, low-light environment where positive ID is imperative, and its slim, compact form factor is compatible with many commercially available holsters already on the market. The XC3's premium LED generates 550 lumens and 7,200 candela of intense white light shaped a Hybrid Beam pattern that delivers the ideal combination of distance and surround light at handgun distances. We've also engineered its intuitive ambidextrous switching to provide a positive tactile feel for unmatched control in momentary- or constant-on mode. Powered by a front-loading, single, readily available 123A lithium battery, the XC3 provides 1.75 hours of constant runtime while allowing easy battery swaps without requiring removal from your handgun. Manufactured of high-strength, aerospace-grade aluminum body, Mil-Spec hard-anodized, and gasket-sealed to thrive in the harshest conditions.
